high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "fruitfinance," located in Mumbai, Maharashtra. The post is on an Explore page, as indicated by the title at the top. The post's content discusses the financial situation of a company, specifically mentioning Evergrande, which is described as the second-largest real estate company in China. The main text of the post states that the company is burdened by a total debt of nearly $312 billion. It provides context by comparing this amount to 2% of China's GDP, emphasizing the scale of the debt.
